title: Identify the holder of Engram's SQLite write lock when a 10 s store-busy refusal recurs, using the landed store-transaction diagnostics
outcome: Identify the holder of Engram's SQLite write lock when a 10 s store-busy refusal recurs, using the landed store-transaction diagnostics
acceptance: When a store-busy (writer_admission_refused) refusal recurs on an operational store, the process and operation holding the SQLite write lock and its hold duration are identified from the store_transaction / store_mutex diagnostics records, or marked explicitly unavailable or ambiguous where coverage does not reach the holder, with the evidence locators recorded
